interpretation: Adult tan skin; source red/white stippling is diagnostic skin coloration. Yellow costume mask, black hair and green waistwrap. Gray source ground shadow omitted for draft transparency. Static visual pose description, not executed animation attribution.

frames.019: Right-facing near-side profile. Long yellow mask seen nearly edge-on in front at screen-right, black hair behind. Both arms raised: one rises above head, the other reaches diagonally up-right in front; open palms. Two nearly planted bare feet, knees slightly flexed.
frames.020: Right-facing profile, both arms extend forward toward screen-right, bent at elbow and different heights, upper hand close to face and lower hand farther right. Feet nearly together, one nearer foot angled forward. Preserve narrow profile torso.
frames.021: Turn toward rear three-quarter right. Screen-left arm bends back with hand on hip; screen-right arm extends gently down-right with palm open. One leg planted at lower-left, other knee lifted in front and bent inward, foot raised.
frames.022: Rear three-quarter right running step. Near arm extends screen-right slightly downward with loosely closed hand; far arm bent back left. Screen-left leg bent sharply backward with raised heel; screen-right leg supports weight with bent knee and foot at lower center-right.
frames.023: Back three-quarter right, long near arm extends horizontally screen-right with fist, far arm trails diagonally down-left. One leg planted down-right, the other trails behind down-left with toe raised. Wrap flares left with turn.
frames.024: More direct rear view, mask only a narrow yellow edge along screen-right of black hair. Arms bent open at waist, screen-right palm raised and screen-left arm back-left. Alternating step: screen-left leg down and screen-right knee lifts sideways with lower leg folded underneath.
frames.025: Rear view, turned slightly right. Arms form a broad high V with open hands; left hand higher and farther left than source026. Show back and shaggy black hair, narrow yellow mask side at right, no frontal face. Feet apart, knees soft, long green wrap hangs centrally.
frames.026: Rear view slightly right. Both arms raised in a narrower, steeper V than025, open palms angled inward. Back and black hair face camera, narrow yellow mask edge at right. Both bare feet down and separated, central green wrap.
frames.027: Rear view. Both elbows curve upward beside head into rounded overhead U, open hands above head, right hand a little higher. Do not substitute wide V. Back of hair and body, thin mask side at right. Feet down, slight knee bend.
frames.028: Rear view. Arms raised in rounded U, but hands held more outward than027 and lower relative head. Body bends subtly left. Back of black hair and torso toward camera, small yellow side of mask at right. Feet separated and down.
frames.029: Rear three-quarter right. Screen-left arm extends back-left bent at elbow around shoulder height. Screen-right elbow bends up so open hand is above/right of head near mask. Back visible, mask side at right. Two planted feet and central hanging wrap.
frames.030: Rear three-quarter right. Screen-left elbow flares out with hand on hip. Screen-right forearm curves up to place hand on TOP of the yellow mask, preparing to lift it. Back of hair toward viewer, no frontal mask eyes. Feet apart.
frames.031: Rear view turning body. Mask removed and held outward at screen-right by extended right arm, yellow mask now angled near-horizontal/diagonal beside upper torso, not worn on face. Left arm bent with hand at hip, broad green wrap swings left. Black hair back visible, bare feet apart with knees bent.
frames.050: Rear three-quarter right, standing with BOTH arms spread wide almost horizontally and palms up, fingers open. Bare back and black shaggy hair toward camera; yellow mask appears only as a thin edge at screen-right. Feet apart, central green wrap.
frames.051: Rear three-quarter right, same stance as050 but BOTH arms lower diagonally outward to either side, palms open. Back and hair toward camera, mask narrow edge at right. Keep both bare feet down and green wrap.
